release_scope: Source publication only; no runtime switch, production deployment, container build or relabeling.
source_commit_resolution: Resolve v1.10.0^{commit} for the final main merge commit; annotated tag must point to that commit.
tag_relation: Runtime, tests, dependencies and migrations identical to accepted implementation; root versions and release documentation updated separately.

rollback.runtime_effect: Source publication does not switch running instances. Production rollback requires its existing image and backup manifest; do not delete credential, idempotency or audit records merely to revert source.
